# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>; Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a young woman with lovely, fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully, wearing sleeve puffs larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

She is bright, sympathetic, and cheerful, possessing a happy gift for winning and holding the affections of her pupils. She guides her students with wholesome influence to bring out the best in them mentally and morally. While soft-hearted enough to forgive freely, she firm-handedly corrects deceit and encourages good work ethics.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as Avonlea's first female teacher. She introduced innovative educational routines to the school, such as physical culture exercises, biweekly recitation afternoons, and outdoor field days to study nature. She formed a deep bond of friendship and mentorship with Anne Shirley and prepared her Queen's class pupils thoroughly for their Entrance examinations. After teaching in Avonlea, her term ended at the end of June, leaving her pupils tearful upon her departure. She advised students like Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe to take up Second Year work at the Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)_
